speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Can you describe exactly what happened right before you lost consciousness, and did you experience any warning signs like dizziness or chest pain?

speaker: Patient
text: I was just finishing urinating when I suddenly passed out; my wife found me on the bathroom floor. I didn't feel any dizziness, chest pain, or other warning signs beforehand. speaker: Doctor
text: Given the sudden loss of consciousness immediately following urination and the confirmed imaging findings, this presentation is classic for micturition syncope. DIAGNOSIS READY: Micturition Syncope
